Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing electronic competitive bidding for state public works contracting.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to electronic competitive bidding for state publicworks contracting; and adding a new section to chapter 39.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any state agency authorized to conduct public works contractingand competitive bidding under this chapter may do so electronically andmay use or accept electronic signatures in these processes. Suchsignatures are deemed presumptively valid and enforceable. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Electronic signature" means a signature in electronic formattached to or logically associated with an electronic record. (b) "State agency" means any state office or activity of theexecutive and judicial branches of state government, including statedepartments, offices, divisions, boards, commissions, institutions ofhigher education as defined in RCW 28B.10.016, and correctional andother types of institutions.
